title: A piacon és a boltban: Shopping to Cook

sections.title: From the market to the pot
sections.content: Units 8-10 taught shopping, food and cooking as separate skills. Chain them into one story: go shopping (vásárol, keres, talál, mennyibe kerül), then cook what you bought (felvág, megfőz), the same imperative-based cooking verbs from Unit 10, now in the past tense.

sections.title: Shopping and cooking, together
rows: I asked how much it costs.
I cut it up, I cooked it

items.spanish: A piacon hagymát, fokhagymát és paprikát vásároltam, mert gulyást akartam főzni.
items.english: At the market I bought onion, garlic and paprika, because I wanted to cook goulash.

items.spanish: Megkérdeztem, mennyibe kerül a hús, aztán megvettem egy kilót.
items.english: I asked how much the meat costs, then I bought a kilo.

items.spanish: Otthon felvágtam a hagymát, és egy nagy fazékban megfőztem.
items.english: At home I cut up the onion, and cooked it in a big pot.

sections.content: kerül only takes -ba/-be with a price — Ez ezer forintba kerül ("This costs a thousand forints") — but in a question about the price you can drop the price and just ask Mennyibe kerül?
